授業科目の概要.科目名称: 学術英語・アカデミックライティング
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、信頼できる情報リソースの強力な論拠とエビデンスによる論述実践を通したライティングスキルの向上を目的とする。教師や他の学生からのフィードバックに基づいて計画、執筆、再執筆を行うライティングプロセスを学ぶことで、将来の学術的および専門的なライティング作業に備える。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to improve students’ writing skills by having them write a research essay featuring strong arguments and evidence from reliable sources. Students will learn a writing process involving planning, writing, and rewriting based on teacher and student feedback. This will prepare students for future academic and professional writing work.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
注意: 生成AIは執筆の際に役立つツールとなりえます。しかし、生成AIはあくまで補助として使用し、代替ツールとして利用することは認められません。生成AIの言葉をコピーして自分が書いたふりをすることは、それが授業で直接許可されない限り、盗作（いわゆるカンニング）と見なされます。生成AIやその他類似のツールのコピーは、得点を失う原因となります。さらに深刻な場合、不合格となる可能性があります。授業によって、生成AIの使用時期や方法について他のルールを設定する場合があります。Notes: Generative AI can be a useful tool when writing. However, generative AI should only be used to help you, never to do work for you. Copying words from generative AI and pretending that you wrote them is considered to be plagiarism (a kind of cheating) unless your instructor directly says it is allowed. Copying from generative AI or any other place will cause you to lose points. If the problem is serious enough, you may fail the class.
In this class, you will use generative AI a lot to help you write your essay, but you may not have the AI write the essay for you. For each assignment, the instructor will explain if and how you can use AI.

head: 授業のテーマ
授業の内容（90分授業＝2時間）
事前/事後学修の内容
rows: Introduce class and academic writing; practice using Word Online; survey 1
Make genAI account; reading from textbook; read list of research questions
Work with GenAI to think of essay topics
Brainstorm keywords, arguments, etc., both alone and with GenAI
Discuss reliable sources and where to find them
Learn about the five-paragraph essay structure, including key sentences; read and discuss examples; practice; survey 2
Study and practice how to build a strong argument across the essay; do peer review on another students' outline
Write response to peer review and revision plan; reading from Moodle
Learn how to write body paragraphs, learn how to cite sources
Study and practice how to make each body paragraph a strong argument; get feedback from GenAI about argument in Draft 1
Write response to GenAI feedback and revision plan
Identify problems in sample arguments and revise them; survey 3
Write response to peer review and revision plan; reading from Moodle
Learn and practice writing conclusions; get feedback from GenAI about conclusion
Do peer review; respond to peer review; learn Introduction paragraphs
Do peer review, receive final draft instructions, begin final essay
Learn other ways to use AI for education; survey 4
